description: A node whose link the peer breaks with PHYSICAL LINK BREAK declares the link broken at once and answers PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM by expedited non-ARQ data.
note: Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215). The peer is recorded Ed4 (B-0408) and the 16-bit family is in force. At 61000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10, so the burst ends by 66000), a type 8 D_PDU carrying PHYSICAL LINK BREAK with reason 4, No More Data (octet 44; any reason is accepted, B-0309), the peer's C_PDU ID 1. This node is the Responder (B-0159, B-0284): the link is broken at once, so cas.first_data stops and link_state goes unlinked; PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM (type 5, one octet 50, B-0161, B-0164) is queued for a type 8 D_PDU (B-0162, B-0165), then D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED goes to the DTS (C-0652: nothing was queued for the link, so nothing is rejected, C-0866) and C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS (B-0285). At 62000 the burst ends with the prediction ahead and the confirm queued: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 66000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms; at 78000 the confirm goes out, our C_PDU ID 1. Its sending needs nothing more: no timer runs for it. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4: contention waits 45000, 12000 ms (K-0080).
